U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (2019). Global Non-CO2 Greenhouse Gas Emission Projections & Marginal Abatement Cost Analysis: Methodology Documentation. EPA-430-R-19-012, September 2019. Prepared by RTI International, Abt Associates Inc. and ICF for the U.S. EPA Office of Atmospheric Programs, Climate Change Division, Washington, DC. (Companion to the summary report EPA-430-R-19-010, registered as background.)

Targeted pass over Section 5 abatement-option tables. Loaded: oil and gas methane options (Table 5-6: gas production, processing and transmission segments; capex, annual O&M, time horizon, technical effectiveness) and break-even prices for nine selected options (Table 5-7); underground coal-mine methane options (Tables 5-1, 5-2 and unit costs in the text); nitric and adipic acid N2O abatement (Table 5-10 and text); HFC-23 thermal oxidation at HCFC-22 plants (text); primary aluminium PFC retrofits (Tables 5-29, 5-30). Not loaded: gas distribution segment of Table 5-6 (cast-iron and steel main and service replacement, M&R; utility scope), semiconductor, PV, flat panel, electric power SF6, magnesium cover gas, refrigeration/AC, foams, aerosols, fire protection, solvents, agriculture, waste (F-gas products and non-industrial sources). Page numbers are PRINTED report page numbers (section-page, e.g. 5-15); the PDF has 287 pages. PRICE YEARS: Table 5-6 states $2008; Table 5-10 and nitric/adipic text 2010 USD; Tables 5-30 2016 USD; coal-mine Table 5-1, its text and the HCFC-22 costs carry no year, and the report elsewhere says constant 2015 USD (Sect. 4.1.2) and 2017$ (Table 4-2): no-year costs are written with 2019 and flagged. TRAPS: Table 5-6 does not say what one unit of capex is (per model facility or component of the Natural Gas STAR example); technical effectiveness is not facility-level reduction efficiency; coal Table 5-1 costs conflict with the text worked examples (electricity 23.0 vs 4.5 million USD) and pipeline injection effectiveness is 21% (Table 5-1) vs 28% (Table 5-2); nitric acid efficiencies (Table 5-10 85/95/95 vs text 80/82/90) and secondary lifetime (15 vs 20 years) conflict; Table 5-7 uses 10% discount and 40% tax versus 5% and 0% in Table 4-2; offshore flaring capex 165.9 million USD per model platform is an outlier.
